records.jp: はあ……
records.en_original: *Sigh*
records.en: *Sigh*

records.jp: はああ…………
records.en_original: *Sigh*
records.en: *Sigh*

records.jp: 太陽がまぶしい……<CR>サングラスとかほしいなあ
records.en_original: It's so bright... I wish I had some sunglasses.
records.en: It's so bright... I wish I had some sunglasses.

records.jp: 学校中探せば、<CR>どこかにありそうな気もしますね
records.en_original: I bet we'd find some if we looked around the school.
records.en: I bet we'd find some if we looked around the school.

records.jp: うーん、でも……今はそういう<CR>面倒なことしたくない気分……
records.en_original: Mmm... That sounds like kind of a lot of work.
records.en: Mmm... That sounds like kind of a lot of work.

records.jp: それは……私も、です。<CR>水の中でふわふわしてるの、気持ちいいですから……
records.en_original: I...agree. Floating in the water feels much too nice...
records.en: I...agree. Floating in the water feels much too nice...

records.jp: 暑い日に、プールでだらだらするの気持ちいい……<CR>このまま水に溶けちゃいそう……
records.en_original: Nothing beats the pool on a hot day like this... I feel like I'll just melt into the water...
records.en: Nothing beats the pool on a hot day like this... I feel like I'll just melt into the water...

records.jp: 溶ける……？　た、大変です。<CR>星崎さん、早くプールから出てください
records.en_original: You'll melt? Th-that's terrible! Ao, you must get out of the pool immediately.
records.en: You'll melt? Th-that's terrible! Hoshizaki-san, you must get out of the pool immediately.

records.jp: わわっ、追い出さないでぇ！<CR>大丈夫、私も詩さんも溶けないから、比喩だから！
records.en_original: H-hey, stop it! I'm not actually melting! It's a figure of speech!
records.en: Whoa, don't kick me out! It's okay—neither Uta-san nor I will melt. It was a figure of speech!

records.jp: あ、そうなんですね。<CR>よかった……
records.en_original: Oh, really? That's a relief...
records.en: Oh, really? That's a relief...

records.jp: うーん、詩さんって基本は素直だけど、<CR>こういう時は天然の才能も感じちゃうなあ
records.en_original: You always act so logical, but you can be surprisingly air-headed.
records.en: Hmm, you're usually straightforward, Uta-san, but at times like this I can sense a natural airhead talent...

records.jp: 天然……？
records.en_original: Air-headed...?
records.en: Air-headed...?

records.jp: いやいや、こっちの話。<CR>詩さんはそのままでいて……
records.en_original: Oh, it's nothing, just talking to myself. Never change, Uta.
records.en: Oh, it's nothing, just talking to myself. Never change, Uta-san.

records.jp: あー、ダメダメ！<CR>このままぼーっとしてたらダメになる！
records.en_original: Ahh, this has gotta stop! We can't let our day go by just spacing out like this!
records.en: Ahh, this has gotta stop! We can't let our day go by just spacing out like this!

records.jp: 詩さん、何かアイデアない？<CR>まだやる気がみなぎってないから、泳ぐの以外で！
records.en_original: Do you have any ideas, Uta? Anything but swimming! I'd come up with something myself, but I've still got zero motivation.
records.en: Do you have any ideas, Uta-san? Anything but swimming! I'd come up with something myself, but I've still got zero motivation.

records.jp: じゃあ、ゆっくり身体を動かすのはどうでしょう？<CR>水中ウォーキングとか、ストレッチとか
records.en_original: How about a little light exercise? Water walking or stretches or something like that.
records.en: How about a little light exercise? Water walking or stretches or something like that.

records.jp: 水中ウォーキング！<CR>いいね、なんか健康的な響き
records.en_original: Ooh, water walking! That sounds healthy!
records.en: Ooh, water walking! That sounds healthy!

records.jp: では、手始めに<CR>このプールを一往復してみましょうか
records.en_original: All right. Let's start by doing a lap around the pool.
records.en: All right. Let's start by doing a lap around the pool.

records.jp: はあ、はあ……
records.en_original: *Pant*... *Pant*...
records.en: *Pant*... *Pant*...

records.jp: はあ……はあっ……！<CR>星崎さん、さっき思い出したんですけど……
records.en_original: *Pant*... *Pant*... Ao... I remembered something... A while back...
records.en: *Pant*... *Pant*... Hoshizaki-san... I remembered something... A while back...

records.jp: 水中ウォーキングって、水圧がある分、<CR>地上よりも疲れるんでした……！
records.en_original: The resistance this a good bit more difficult than walking on land...
records.en: The resistance this a good bit more difficult than walking on land...

records.jp: ど、どうりで……っ！
records.en_original: Y-you're tellin' me!
records.en: Y-you're tellin' me!

records.jp: ストレッチかあ。<CR>それなら楽にできるかも！
records.en_original: Stretches? That sounds nice and easy!
records.en: Stretches? That sounds nice and easy!

records.jp: 私もそんなに体力がある方じゃないですし、<CR>のんびりやっていきましょう
records.en_original: I tire easily as well. Let's take it nice and slow.
records.en: I tire easily as well. Let's take it nice and slow.

records.jp: あー、伸ばした伸ばした！<CR>気持ちよかったあ
records.en_original: Ahh! I'm all loosened up! That felt great!
records.en: Ahh! I'm all loosened up! That felt great!

records.jp: 思ったより長い時間、やってしまいましたね。<CR>少しだけ、疲れたかも……
records.en_original: We went longer than I thought we would. I'm a little tired...
records.en: We went longer than I thought we would. I'm a little tired...

records.jp: えっ、ごめん！　気づかなかった！
records.en_original: Ah, sorry! I didn't notice!
records.en: Ah, sorry! I didn't notice!

records.jp: いえ、気づかなくて当然です。<CR>言いませんでしたから
records.en_original: No, it's natural that you didn't. I didn't say anything, after all.
records.en: No, it's natural that you didn't. I didn't say anything, after all.

records.jp: 星崎さんが楽しそうだから、<CR>止めずに見ていたくなったんです
records.en_original: You seemed to be having so much fun, I wanted to continue on watching you.
records.en: You looked like you were having fun, Hoshizaki-san, so I wanted to keep watching instead of stopping you.

records.jp: そ、そうなの？<CR>まあ、詩さんも楽しめてたなら、良かったよ
records.en_original: R-really? Well, as long as you had fun...
records.en: R-really? Well, if you had fun too, Uta-san, I'm glad.

records.jp: じゃあ、そろそろ休もうか
records.en_original: Let's take a break then, shall we?
records.en: Let's take a break then, shall we?

records.jp: はい。<CR>たくさん運動しましたしね
records.en_original: I agree. We got a good amount of exercise.
records.en: I agree. We got a good amount of exercise.

records.jp: ふう……<CR>まだまだ陽射しがきついですね
records.en_original: Phew... The sun is very strong, isn't it?
records.en: Phew... The sun is very strong, isn't it?

records.jp: そうだねえ。<CR>……あ
records.en_original: Yeah... Oh.
records.en: Yeah... Oh.

records.jp: 詩さんって、<CR>改めて見ると、肌白いよね
records.en_original: You're skin is so pale... It's like porcelain.
records.en: Looking again, Uta-san, your skin really is pale.

records.jp: え？　ほ、星崎さん？
records.en_original: Huh? A-Ao?
records.en: Huh? H-Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: （ほっぺもすべすべで、濡れた桃みたい。<CR>　かじったら甘そう……）
records.en_original: (Her cheeks are smooth...almost like peaches. They look like they'd be sweet if I bit into them...)
records.en: (Her cheeks are smooth...almost like peaches. They look like they'd be sweet if I bit into them...)

records.jp: ……星崎さん、どうしたんですか？
records.en_original: Ao...? Is something the matter?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san...? Is something the matter?

records.jp: えっ！？　な、何も！？
records.en_original: Huh?! N-nothing!
records.en: Huh?! N-nothing!

records.jp: ……そう、ですか。<CR>顔が近いので、何か起きたのかと少し驚きました
records.en_original: Is that so... You were so close to my face, I'd thought something was wrong.
records.en: Is that so... You were so close to my face, I'd thought something was wrong.

records.jp: ご、ごめんごめん！　あはは……
records.en_original: S-sorry! Ahaha...
records.en: S-sorry! Ahaha...

records.jp: （あ、危ない！<CR>　うっかりはむってしちゃうところだったー！）
records.en_original: (Th-that was close! I almost really nibbled her!)
records.en: (Th-that was close! I almost really nibbled her!)

records.jp: 私、ちょっと日焼けしちゃったかも。<CR>ほら、腕のここ
records.en_original: Oops, I think I got a little sunburned. See, on my arm?
records.en: Oops, I think I got a little sunburned. See, on my arm?

records.jp: 少し赤くなってますね。<CR>……あ、首の後ろも
records.en_original: It is a little red. Oh, the back of your neck as well...
records.en: It is a little red. Oh, the back of your neck as well...

records.jp: うわー、やっちゃった。<CR>って、詩さんも肩の後ろ、少し焼けてない？
records.en_original: Shoot, now I've done it... Wait, I think the back of your shoulders got burned too.
records.en: Oh no, I did it. Wait, aren't the backs of your shoulders a little sunburned too, Uta-san?

records.jp: あ……本当ですね。<CR>後で、ちゃんと冷やさないと
records.en_original: Oh... You're right. We should find a way to cool our skin.
records.en: Oh... You're right. We should find a way to cool our skin.

records.jp: 二人とも、身体の後ろだからやりにくそー。<CR>……そうだ、保冷剤で冷やしっこしない？
records.en_original: Gonna be hard when our burns are on our backs... Wanna ice pack each other?
records.en: Gonna be hard when our burns are on our backs... Wanna ice pack each other?

records.jp: 冷やしっこ……ふふ
records.en_original: Ice pack each other... Hehe.
records.en: Ice pack each other... Hehe.

records.jp: え、今の笑うとこ？
records.en_original: Huh? Did I say something funny?
records.en: Huh? Did I say something funny?

records.jp: いえ、楽しそうだな……と。<CR>私、もうダメってなるまで頑張りますね！
records.en_original: No, you just looked like you were having so much fun. I'll ice pack you until my arms give out!
records.en: No, you just looked like you were having so much fun. I'll ice pack you until my arms give out!

records.jp: 気合いが入っていらっしゃる……<CR>冷やしっこって、そんな頑張るものだったっけ！？
records.en_original: You sure are fired up... Is it gonna be that much work?!
records.en: You sure are fired up... Is it gonna be that much work?!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
